errors.evidence: The description states there are five geographical units, but the x-axis and the text itself list six categories: "Общо за страната", "Северозападен район", "Видин", "Враца", "Ловеч", and "Монтана".
The categories on the x-axis are not sorted in alphabetical order. The order is "Общо за страната", "Северозападен район", "Видин", "Враца", "Ловеч", "Монтана".
The color corresponding to the year 2020 is light blue/cyan, not dark blue. The dark blue color represents the year 2016.
The legend is located on the right side of the plot area, centered vertically, not in the upper right corner.

errors.text_span: а най-ниските – за „Монтана“ през 2016 г. (около 200 лв.)
errors.evidence: The lowest value on the chart is for the "Видин" category in 2016 (approximately 210 BGN), not for "Монтана" in 2016, which is approximately 250 BGN. The value of 200 BGN is also incorrect for Montana in 2016.

errors.text_span: различни административни единици в Северозападна България
errors.evidence: This is an over-generalization because one of the categories, "Общо за страната" (Total for the country), represents the national average and is not an administrative unit within Northwestern Bulgaria.
